purpose: Execute the already-defined E05 Hosted lifecycle zero-infrastructure-fan-out claim and preserve independently recountable database, audit, Outbox, access-negative, infrastructure inventory and shared-host release evidence. This record mirrors the active E2.0 trace matrix and does not create or expand a product contract.

implementation_basis.role: Production Hosted node creation transaction and append-only node/relation/capability facts
Historical shared-host release workflow used by the frozen production receipt

regression_basis.role: Frozen E v1 zero-fan-out infrastructure count record

environment_classification: A successful clean-source disposable PostgreSQL 17 lifecycle execution plus a live read-only GitHub reconciliation of the frozen historical shared-host production release can establish DEV VERIFIED only. The historical production receipt is supporting evidence and does not elevate the full lifecycle claim to PRODUCTION VERIFIED.

operation_authority.suspend_reactivate_grant_revoke: Existing E05 matrix-scoped direct database lifecycle transitions; no new public operation or API contract is introduced by this retest.
operation_authority.access_observation: A raw database authorization projection requires active node, active Membership, unexpired allow scope and enabled entitlement; each stage is captured instead of trusting a fixture PASS boolean.

prelocked_thresholds: three-node and five-operation completeness mismatch count = 0
unexpected database, audit or Outbox fact count = 0
reactivated or granted expected-access denial count = 0
historical GitHub workflow receipt mismatch count = 0
business source count or digest change = 0
positive_cases: All three original synthetic Hosted nodes gain only the expected lifecycle data facts, audit rows and Outbox rows.
The suspended sample loses base access and regains it only after reactivation.
The granted sample gains extra access and loses it after revocation.
One historical shared-host release has one build, one artifact identity, one deploy and one restart for all Hosted samples.
negative_cases: Detect any Hosted-specific manifest, pointer, process, port or infrastructure action.
Detect residual access after suspension or revocation.
Detect a repeated per-Hosted-node build, deploy or restart.
Detect an unexpected database, audit or Outbox fact.

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently reconstruct the three-node five-operation sequence from raw node, relation, Membership, scope, entitlement, audit and Outbox rows; recompute every stage access decision; enumerate Hosted manifest/resource/process/port/source/build facts; reconcile the frozen shared-host receipt with a fresh read-only GitHub workflow observation and its historical workflow source; then mutate copies to prove detection of residual access, Hosted infrastructure objects, per-node releases and unexpected facts. Do not consume runner PASS fields.

unknown_rule: Missing any required artifact, node/operation stage, before/after row, audit or Outbox record, access decision input, infrastructure counter, process/port/manifest/pointer inventory, shared-release field, GitHub workflow identity, source inventory, build observation or environment fact yields UNKNOWN.

outcome_table.condition: All required raw evidence exists; all three nodes and five operations are complete; only expected data/audit/Outbox facts exist; access denial/restoration is exact; every Hosted infrastructure count is zero; the shared release is exactly one build/artifact/deploy/restart with zero per-node actions; source inventory is stable; every negative mutation is detected.
Any complete raw observation contradicts a prelocked data, access, infrastructure, shared-release, source/build or isolation threshold.
Any required artifact or raw field is missing, unreadable or cannot be independently reconciled.

review_classification: The criteria designer, executor and oracle operator are the same Codex task; the result remains NOT REVIEWED until a reviewer independent of the E05 lifecycle fixture, release receipt and counting code recomputes and signs it.
